bio: Educación financiera rápida, dibujada y al grano. Aprende a dominar tu dinero, salir de deudas e invertir en menos de 2 minutos. 💸🧠

outro_prompt.description: Animated logo outro for the channel 'Hackea tu Riqueza', hand-drawn 2D webcomic sketch style. The scene starts with a clean white background. A striking green lightning bolt flashes down from the top center. Instantly, thick expressive black ink lines rapidly sketch the channel logo (a lightbulb with wings) around the lightning bolt.
